newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore Refining shuts hydrocracker for 10 days.
newsitem.headline: Singapore Refining shuts hydrocracker for 10 days.

text.p: Singapore Refining Co (SRC) has shut down its 14,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) hydrocracker No.2 on February 18 for 10 days, an industry source said on Thursday.

The unscheduled cracker shutdown is ahead of SRC's planned turnaround of its 90,000-bpd crude distillation unit, 18,000-bpd hydrocracker and 18 million cubic feet per day hydrogen plant from March 2-22, the source said.
It also plans to shutdown a 32,000-bpd visbreaker from March 4-17.
SRC is 40 percent owned by Singapore Petroleum Co Ltd, with the remaining stakes divided equally between British Petroleum and Caltex, a joint-venture between Texaco Inc and Chevron Corp.
